method: Booking.com property pages with explicit dates 2027-02-15 → 2027-02-22, 2 adults, 1 room, USD. Room type, bed, bathroom and displayed stay total captured verbatim. Taxes excluded unless stated; Booking.com shows 'Excluded: 14.75% TAX, $4 City tax per night' on many rates.

rows.name: Eurostars Wall Street
rows.tax_note: Excludes 14.75% tax + $4/night city tax (US$149.66 tax for the stay, as displayed)
rows.rate_terms: Partner Offer, non-refundable, pay in advance, breakfast $21/person extra
rows.nearest_subway: Wall St (2/3) — hotel is in the Financial District
rows.notes: Cheapest verified queen-bed option in the preferred week. Non-refundable at this rate; a refundable 'Black Friday' rate was displayed at $1,025 pre-tax for the same room.

rows.nearest_subway: 28th Street station — 1,056 ft per property description

flags: H-01: Booking.com '1 week, 2 adults' totals generally EXCLUDE taxes (14.75% + $4/night city tax) — real totals are ~16–18% higher.
H-02: Some displayed rates are 'Partner Offer' (non-refundable, third-party) or include mandatory resort fees ($38/night at Evelyn and Frederick).

H-03: No hotel page explicitly states 'private bathroom' as a filterable attribute in the captured text except through room descriptions; Booking.com does offer a 'Private bathroom' filter (554 properties in NYC at capture). Each shortlisted room lists 'Bath'/'Attached bathroom'/'Private bathroom' — cited per row.
H-04: Displayed per-night figures sometimes exclude mandatory fees and therefore do not multiply to the stay total (Benjamin; Evelyn). Totals are the authoritative displayed number.
